name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.8.0
body:
- **Search** has been added to Files and profile pickers.
- MiSTer is now supported in gameID Consoles. [mrext remote](https://github.com/wizzomafizzo/mrext/blob/main/docs/remote.md) must be installed on your MiSTer.
  - Supports Cores by using the core name: ex: "MegaDrive"
  - and/or Games by using Core name and game file name with a | inbetween: ex: "MegaDrive|Streets of Rage 2 (USA)"
  - You do not have to use the exact name as long as it contains enough characters to match.
  - Recommend turning off "Auto Load DV1" if using HDMI DV1 for the time being or else it will override. A RetroTink bug fix will soon allow both to work together.
- gameID Consoles / gameDB now support "any" profile not just SVS based ones. Previous SVS-based config automatically gets migrated over to file based profiles.
- New **HDMI Info Profiles** can load any "HDMI Input" profile based on HDMI SPD/VSIF metadata.
  - Match on Product Description, Vendor Name, or Game ID with MakeMHz/Stellar XboxHD+ and Pixel-FX mods.
- Update **HDMI Output** Custom1 - 4 modelines directly on Dashboard.
- **HDMI Info** card replaces RT Superloop card on Dashboard.
  - RT Superloop stats moved to RT Diagnostics tab
- "RT Diagnostics" updated to support the new "vmeas" 224 byte / 113 fields map.
- "Extra Remote Button Profiles" section now supports any profile, not just SVS.
- "Switch Fallback" allows gameID / HDMI Info Profiles to return to Extron1/SW1 & Extron2/SW2 active inputs when there is no match.
- Files now has cut/copy/paste vs move which also allows you to navigate to the destination vs providing the path.
- Mobile "double-tap" navigation on each Menu item jumps between upper and lower sections.
  - Remote + OSD will jump between both types of remotes.
- gameID / Settings tab has been renamed to "Profiles / Settings"
- Profile History and Diagnostic cards can be enabled for troubleshooting. 
- gameID Consoles / gameDB / HDMI Info Profiles tables can all be resized and re-ordered by dragging.
- Updated internal WebServer library to the latest / more stable version. (3.3.12)
- DonutShop firmware updates now use PSRAM for staging which is much faster than LittleFS.
- Internal memory and profile arbitration optimizations.
